claim.claim-text: 2. A system according to Claim 1, wherein the drive system (34) includes a first rolling element (38) configured to contact a radially-outer surface of the drum (20) to enable the first rolling element (38) to drive rotation of the drum (20) about the central axis (46).

3. A system according to Claim 2, wherein the drive system (34) includes a frame (35) and a second rolling element (36), wherein the frame (35) is coupled to a radially-outer surface of the additional drum (74) and is configured to support the second rolling element (36), wherein the second rolling element (36) is configured to contact a radially-inner surface of the track (12) to enable forward and rearward movement of the capsule (14') along the track (12).

4. A system according to any previous claim, wherein the drive system (34) is operatively coupled to an axle (76) of the system, wherein the axle (76) is coupled to the drum to enable rotation of the drum (20) about the central axis (46).

5. A system according to Claim 4, wherein the drive system (34) comprises motors configured to rotate the axle (76) and the drum (20) in a first direction about the central axis (46) and/or in a second direction about the central axis (46).
6. A system according to Claim 1, wherein the drive system (34) comprises a plurality of rolling elements (36, 38) that are spherical tires, ring-shaped tires, or a combination thereof.
7. A system according to any previous claim, wherein the drive system (34) comprises a spherical induction motor.

8. A system according to any previous claim, wherein the drive system (34) is configured to drive rotation of the drum (20) about the central axis (46), and forward or rearward movement of the capsule (14') along the track (12), simultaneously.

9. A system according to any previous claim, comprising a platform (22) of the capsule (14') supporting a restraint (28) for a passenger and configured to fit within the chamber, wherein the platform (22) is configured to move along a platform track (26) internal to the drum (20) between an open position and a closed position relative to the drum (20), wherein in the open position the capsule (14') is open to enable the passenger enter or exit the capsule (14'), and wherein in the closed position the capsule (14') is closed.

10. A system according to any previous claim, comprising: a screen (58) positioned in the drum (20) and configured to display images; and, a controller (62) configured to instruct the screen (58) to display images or other media that correlates to motion of the capsule (14').

11. A system according to any previous claim, comprising: an input device configured to receive an input from a passenger in the drum (20); and, a controller (62) configured to receive the input from the input device and to control the drive system (34) to adjust a parameter related to movement of the capsule (14') based on the received input.
12. A system according to any previous claim, wherein the additional drum (74) is coupled to the drum (20) via at least a portion of the drive system (34).

disposing a drum (20) of a capsule (14') within an additional drum (74) of the capsule (14'), wherein the drum (20) comprises a wall defining a chamber; driving rotation of the drum (20), via a drive system (34), about a central axis (46) of the drum (20) and relative to the additional drum (74); and, driving forward or rearward movement of the capsule (14'), via the drive system (34), along a track (12), wherein the central axis (46) of the drum (20) is parallel to a direction of travel (16) of the forward and rearward movement of the capsule (14') along the track (12).
14. A method according to Claim 13, comprising simultaneously driving rotation of the drum (20) and forward or rearward movement of the capsule (14').

15. A method according to Claim 13 or Claim 14, comprising instructing, via a controller (62), a screen (58) positioned in the drum (20) to display images or other media that correlates to motion of the capsule (14').
